description: This file provides an implementation for a SAX parser handler that processes an XML description of Android APIs. It extracts packages, classes, interfaces, methods, constructors, fields, and parameters from the XML and populates an ApiList data structure.

classes.name: ApiDescrHandler
classes.description: A handler class for SAX parser that processes XML elements related to Android API descriptions and constructs an internal API representation.

methods.name: ApiDescrHandler
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the handler with an ApiList instance.

methods.name: getApiList
methods.description: Returns the current ApiList object after parsing.

methods.name: startElement
methods.description: Handles the start of an XML element, instantiating or updating in-memory representations of packages, classes, methods, etc.

methods.name: endElement
methods.description: Handles the end of an XML element, finalizing and adding constructed method, class, or package objects to their containers.
